rationale.reason: The complete agricultural crawler tractor is a subset of 8701.30; dozers and wheeled tractors are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Manufacture of new complete self-propelled agricultural track-laying tractors, including separately declared twin-track, four-track and steel-track configurations. Engine, transmission, final drive, steering/braking, track running gear, installed hydraulics, hitch and operator station belong to the configured accepted supply. The historical MT700 example illustrates components and track options, not a universal design. (`mt700-2017`)

Exclude construction crawler dozers, excavators, wheeled and pedestrian-controlled tractors, separately sold implements and parts, farm traction services, field fuel, crop production, maintenance and end-of-life. No service reference or life-normalized equivalence is defined.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete agricultural crawler tractors; one track architecture and configured supply per dataset.
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Construction dozers, wheeled/pedestrian tractors, separately sold implements and parts; field services.
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New complete accepted tractor; transport packaging and separate implements excluded.

evidence_limitations: Historical manufacturer documents support route/configuration examples only; current supplier specifications and measured foreground records govern each dataset.
No universal machine mass, manufacturing loss, coating recipe, lifetime or emissions factor established.
Inventory is a process-specific starting set; actual BOM, utilities, consumables, losses and species records must be reconciled and expanded before any completeness claim.
